BillHeading.Sponsors: House Labor & Workplace Standards (originally sponsored by Representatives Reeves, Reed, Berry, Walen, Ramel, and Pollet)
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Requiring employers to reimburse employees for necessary expenditures and losses.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring employers to reimburse employees for necessary expenditures and losses; adding a new section to chapter 49.12 RCW; and providing an effective date.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 49.12 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: (1) An employer shall reimburse an employee for all necessary expenditures and losses incurred by the employee in direct consequence of the discharge of the employee's duties. Reimbursement must be paid within 30 days of the employer's actual or constructive notice of the expenditure or loss.
(2) The failure of an employer to reimburse an employee under this section constitutes a loss of wages equal to the amount of the reimbursement owed to the employee.

(3) The department may adopt rules to implement and enforce this section. For the purpose of enforcing this section, the reimbursement requirement under this section constitutes a wage payment requirement under RCW 49.48.082.
